sections.heading: 1. Lighter and closer
lines: ① Both straps on, snug to your back.
② Leave the charger and spare shoes at work.
③ Pack the heaviest items closest to your back.
④ Rows and farmer's carries, 2–3 times a week.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Weakness in a hand or leg

caption:
Laptop, charger, lunch, gym gear, spare shoes. Sound like your backpack?

Carrying a bag is normal, and your body can adapt to it. Trouble tends to start when it's very heavy, worn over one shoulder, or carried a long way every day.

Use both straps, keep the bag snug against your back, pack heavy items closest to you and leave what you can at work. Rows and farmer's carries two or three times a week help your body handle the load.

Pain spreading down an arm or leg, pins and needles or weakness is worth an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🎒
